title: Visual Shot List
description: The visual-planning LLM's output: an ordered array of generated_shot entries covering the full narration timeline. Validated against schemas/visual-shot.schema.json#/$defs/generated_shot before being handed to persist_generated_shots() -- start_ms/end_ms/duration_ms are deliberately NOT part of this shape, since those are always derived server-side from the voiceover's own timing package, never trusted from the LLM. See docs/architecture/visual-asset-pipeline.md#shot-list.
